exposure: history of GDM in previous pregnancy
cohort: 200 pregnant women of Western Rajasthan, India (183 completed follow-up)
finding: BMI >= 25 kg/m^2, age > 25 years, and history of GDM in previous pregnancy were independent risk factors for GDM.
